patterns.comment: Generic argument clause after a class-like name: `Box<...>`. Highlights the angle brackets as operators so they stand out from the bundled PHP grammar that would otherwise miss them. The look-behind is intentionally single-character (fixed-length) because IntelliJ's TextMate plugin uses Joni, which rejects variable-length look-behinds (a `*`-quantified character class fails to compile, the whole rule is skipped, and generic-clause highlighting silently doesn't fire). VS Code's Oniguruma accepts both forms; a single-char identifier-class match here is enough to distinguish `Box<` from a comparison ` < `.
